method.scope: Live runtime selection maps + default-route spawn systems only. Filenames and design prose are not treated as usage proof.
method.liveAdmissionPath: renderer.js installs installVisualOverrides with directAuthoredMount:true; ship entities receive a zero-draw substrate then wrapShipWithAuthoredParts admits authored GLBs. Bespoke FACTION_BUILDERS procedural heroes are skipped on the live direct path and only act as non-direct fallback substrates.
method.frequencyModel: Time-weighted concurrent presence estimate for first ~30 minutes assuming Helios-heavy play (≈55% Helios, 20% Ceres, 15% Tethys, 10% Vesta). Traffic counts from trafficPerMin→ambientCountForSector; role mix from trafficRoleMixForSector; hostiles from enemyDensity×_enemyPool; dressing from _spawn*Dressing caps. Estimates are ordered ranks, not absolute ship-counts from a telemetry run.
ambiguities: Cockpit/fin/greeble modular picks are pure entity-id seed hashes — not faction maps — so per-faction part frequency is entity-population dependent.
EncounterDirector weighted shapes add late-route variety; first-hour core (Helios enemyDensity 0) is dominated by traffic + stations + dressing, not director combat packs.
WHOLE_SHIP_LOD_FAMILY_BY_DEF_ID catalogs lod1/lod2 files, but live whole-ship seam currently uses LOD0 only (partsLibrary.js comments at 395–398).
place_dock_interior* appear in UI hangar preview only (shipPreviewMount.js), not flight-space world spawns.
wholeship_pelican / wholeship_wasp (non-production) exist in parts_manifest but are not referenced by WHOLE_SHIP_* maps.
